ticket.no-animals: No animals yet, so no visitors will come.
ticket.crowd-free: Free entry! The zoo will be packed, but there's no ticket income.

ticket.crowd-up-pricey: A few more visitors now, but tickets are still pricey (about {{visitors}} a day).
ticket.crowd-down: Tickets are a bit pricey, so fewer visitors are coming (about {{visitors}} a day).
ticket.crowd-empty: Tickets are way too expensive. The zoo is getting empty (about {{visitors}} a day).
review.empty: No reviews yet. Visitors will write some after a day of tours.

review.price.low: {{stars}}  Such a bargain! I'll tell my friends.
review.price.free: {{stars}}  Free day at the zoo! The kids loved it.
review.animals.few: {{stars}}  Hardly any animals. Come back when it's stocked.
review.animals.many: {{stars}}  So many animals! Could have stayed all day.
review.habitats.few: {{stars}}  Most pens were empty. Felt unfinished.
review.habitats.many: {{stars}}  Loved walking the loop past every habitat.
review.overall.great: {{stars}}  Best zoo in the valley. I'll be back tomorrow!
review.overall.ok: {{stars}}  A nice little zoo. Cute exhibits.
record.title: Zoo Recording Studio
record.hint: Pick an animal, then Record, Preview, or Reset to default. * = custom sound. You can also put your own WAV in the sounds folder; it loads automatically.
record.listening: Recording {{animal}} for 2.5 seconds... make the sound now!
record.silent: The recording was silent, so the old sound was kept. On macOS, allow Terminal (SMAPI runs inside it) under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone, then restart the game. Or drop {{file}} into the sounds folder.
record.drop-wav: No microphone recorder is available. The sounds folder is open: drop in a WAV named {{file}} and it loads automatically. (Optional: brew install ffmpeg.)
record.invalid: {{file}} couldn't be used ({{error}}). Save it as a 16-bit PCM WAV.
visitor.name: Visitor
chat.price.free.1: Free admission? Are you sure? ...I'm not complaining!
chat.price.free.2: No ticket at all! I'm spending the money on snacks instead.
chat.price.free.3: A free zoo! Best thing to happen to Pelican Town since the bus got fixed.
chat.price.free.4: I walked right in without paying. Felt a little sneaky, honestly.
chat.price.free.5: Free entry today. Somebody here has a very generous heart.
chat.price.bargain.1: Only {{price}}g to get in? That's practically a gift.
chat.price.bargain.2: For {{price}}g I expected a goat and a fence. This is so much more!
chat.price.bargain.3: What a bargain. I'd have happily paid more than {{price}}g.
chat.price.bargain.4: {{price}}g! I spend more than that at the Stardrop Saloon on a Tuesday.
chat.price.bargain.5: Cheap tickets, cute animals. My kind of day out.
chat.price.bargain.6: I told my wallet it could relax today.
chat.price.fair.1: {{price}}g feels about right for a place like this.
chat.price.fair.2: The ticket was {{price}}g. Fair enough, I'd say.
chat.price.fair.3: Not cheap, not pricey. Just a nice honest ticket.
chat.price.fair.4: Worth the {{price}}g so far. Let's see what's around the corner.
chat.price.fair.5: I don't mind paying {{price}}g when the animals look this happy.
chat.price.pricey.1: {{price}}g is a bit steep... but okay, the animals are cute.
chat.price.pricey.3: Hmm, {{price}}g. I'll have to skip the snacks today.
chat.price.pricey.4: A little pricey. I'd come more often if it were cheaper.
chat.price.pricey.5: For {{price}}g I was hoping to see a few more animals.
chat.price.pricey.6: I had to count my coins twice at the gate.
chat.price.outrageous.1: {{price}}g?! Do the animals get a cut of that?
chat.price.outrageous.2: I paid {{price}}g to get in. I'm staring at every single animal to get my money's worth.
chat.price.outrageous.3: {{price}}g! I could buy a whole cow from Marnie for that. Well... almost.
chat.price.outrageous.4: Highway robbery at the ticket booth, I tell you.
chat.price.outrageous.5: At {{price}}g a ticket, I expected the animals to sing.
chat.favorite.here.1: The {{animal}}! I came all this way just to see the {{animal}}!
chat.favorite.here.2: I could watch the {{animal}} all day. Don't tell the others.
chat.favorite.here.3: The {{animal}} is my favourite animal in the whole world, and here it is!
chat.favorite.here.4: Oh, the {{animal}}! Today is already a good day.
chat.favorite.here.5: I brought a sketchbook just to draw the {{animal}}.
chat.favorite.missing.1: No {{animal}} here? Aw. That's my favourite animal.
chat.favorite.missing.2: I was really hoping to see the {{animal}}. Maybe next time?
chat.favorite.missing.3: If this place ever adds the {{animal}}, I'm buying a season pass.
chat.favorite.missing.4: Do you think they'll get the {{animal}} someday? A visitor can dream.
chat.favorite.missing.5: Everything's lovely, but I keep looking around for the {{animal}}...
chat.habitat.empty.1: Nobody lives in the {{habitat}} pen yet. I hope something moves in someday.
chat.habitat.empty.2: This {{habitat}} pen is so quiet. Is anyone hiding in there?
chat.habitat.empty.3: I stared at the empty {{habitat}} pen for a whole minute, just in case.
chat.habitat.empty.4: What do you think will live in the {{habitat}} pen? My guess is something fluffy.
chat.habitat.empty.5: An empty {{habitat}} pen... it looks like it's waiting for someone.
chat.habitat.empty.6: The {{habitat}} pen has its sign up, but no animals yet. Exciting!
chat.habitat.full.1: Every single pen has someone in it. This zoo really feels finished.
chat.habitat.full.2: From the ice to the jungle, every habitat is full of life!
chat.habitat.full.3: I walked the whole loop and didn't see one empty pen.
chat.habitat.full.4: Somebody planned this place with a lot of love.
chat.zoo.empty.2: I think I'm the most interesting thing in this zoo right now.
chat.zoo.empty.3: Lovely fences. Very sturdy. No animals, though.
chat.zoo.empty.4: Maybe the animals are all on vacation?
chat.zoo.small.1: It's a small zoo, but it's cozy.
chat.zoo.small.2: Only a couple of animals so far. I bet it'll grow.
chat.zoo.small.3: That didn't take long to see everything. I might go around again.
chat.zoo.small.4: Cute start! Can't wait to see what gets added next.
chat.rating.new.1: Nobody's written any reviews yet. I might be the first!
chat.rating.new.2: I saw a poster for this place at Pierre's. Brand new, right?
chat.rating.new.3: A brand new zoo in the valley! I had to come see it.
chat.rating.new.4: No reviews on the board yet. I'll make up my own mind.
chat.rating.great.1: My friend said this place got great reviews. They were right!
chat.rating.great.2: Everyone in Zuzu City is talking about this zoo. {{rating}} stars on average!
chat.rating.great.3: I read the review board on the way in. People really love it here.
chat.rating.great.4: The reviews said 'best zoo in the valley.' No pressure!
chat.rating.great.5: With reviews like these, I had to see it for myself.
chat.rating.ok.1: The reviews said it was 'nice.' So far... yep, nice.
chat.rating.ok.2: About {{rating}} stars on the board. Decent!
chat.rating.ok.3: People seem to like it well enough. I'm keeping an open mind.
chat.rating.ok.4: Mixed reviews, but I like to judge for myself.
chat.rating.poor.1: I read some grumpy reviews before coming. Let's see if they're fair.
chat.rating.poor.2: My friend said this place was disappointing. I'm giving it a chance.
chat.rating.poor.4: The review board was... not kind. I hope things get better here.
chat.rating.poor.5: I almost didn't come after reading the reviews.
chat.time.morning.1: Nothing beats a zoo in the morning. Everyone's so lively!
chat.time.morning.2: I got here early to beat the crowds. Smart, right?
chat.time.morning.3: The animals look like they just woke up. Same.
chat.time.morning.4: Morning! I skipped breakfast to come here. Regrets.
chat.time.midday.1: Is it lunchtime yet? Watching animals makes me hungry.
chat.time.midday.2: The midday crowd is starting to roll in.
chat.time.midday.3: Lunch break at the zoo. Better than the office, that's for sure.
chat.time.midday.4: I think the animals get sleepy after lunch, too.
chat.time.afternoon.1: Ah, a lazy afternoon at the zoo. Perfect.
chat.time.afternoon.2: I should head home soon, but just one more loop...
chat.time.afternoon.3: The afternoon light makes everything look so golden.
chat.time.afternoon.4: Almost closing time. I'm going to say goodbye to everyone.
chat.weather.Sunny.1: What a beautiful day for a zoo trip!
chat.weather.Sunny.2: Sunshine and animals. Can't ask for more.
chat.weather.Sunny.3: I almost went to the beach today. Glad I came here instead.
chat.weather.Rain.1: It's pouring outside! Thank goodness this zoo has a roof.
chat.weather.Rain.2: Rainy days are perfect zoo days.
chat.weather.Rain.3: I left my umbrella by the door. Hope it's still there.
chat.weather.Rain.4: The penguins would probably love this weather.
chat.weather.Storm.1: Did you hear that thunder? The animals don't seem to mind.
chat.weather.Storm.2: I ran in here to hide from the storm. Best decision ever.
chat.weather.Snow.1: Brrr, it's snowing! Warm zoo, happy me.
chat.weather.Snow.2: I built a snowman on the way here. He looked a bit like a penguin.
chat.weather.Snow.3: The snow makes the whole valley so quiet and pretty.
chat.weather.Wind.1: So windy outside! I nearly lost my hat on the way.
chat.weather.Wind.2: Leaves everywhere today. I think one is still in my hair.
chat.weather.Wind.3: The wind out there is wild. In here it's so calm.
chat.town.1: After this I'm getting a pizza at the Stardrop Saloon.
chat.town.2: I took the bus all the way from Zuzu City for this!
chat.town.3: Pelican Town is so peaceful. I could get used to it.
chat.town.4: I passed Pierre's on the way. He was talking about this zoo too.
chat.town.5: Have you seen the fountain in town? Lovely little place.
chat.town.6: I heard Mayor Lewis wants to put the zoo in the town newsletter.
chat.farmer.1: Is that {{farmer}}? The one who runs this place?
chat.farmer.2: I heard {{farmer}} built this whole zoo on {{farm}} Farm. Amazing!
chat.farmer.3: {{farmer}}, right? You look tired. Running a zoo must be hard work!
chat.farmer.4: My aunt buys vegetables from {{farm}} Farm. Now there's a zoo too?
chat.farmer.5: You're the farmer, aren't you? Your animals look so well cared for.
chat.kids.1: My kids keep asking for snacks. Is there a snack stand?
chat.kids.2: My little one wants to take an animal home. I said no. Probably.
chat.kids.3: The kids want ice cream. I want ice cream. Everyone wants ice cream.
chat.kids.4: My son has been making animal noises since we got here.
chat.kids.5: My daughter named every animal. They're all called 'Sparkle.'
chat.kids.6: I promised the kids we'd be home by dinner. Hmm.
chat.hint.cheaper.1: If the tickets were a bit cheaper, I'd bring my whole family next time.
chat.hint.cheaper.2: My neighbours said they'd come too, if it didn't cost so much.
chat.hint.cheaper.3: A lot of folks turned around at the ticket booth when they saw the price.
chat.hint.cheaper.4: I'd come every week if I could afford it.
chat.hint.pricier.1: Honestly? I would have paid quite a bit more for this.
chat.hint.pricier.2: Don't tell anyone, but these tickets are way too cheap.
chat.hint.pricier.3: I think you could charge more and people would still line up.
chat.hint.pricier.4: Such a nice zoo for so little. Are you sure that's sustainable?
chat.hint.variety.1: It'd be fun to see a few more kinds of animals here.
chat.hint.variety.2: I like what's here, but I wish there was more variety.
chat.hint.variety.3: A couple more species and this place would be amazing.
chat.hint.variety.4: My friend asked what animals there are. The list was short!
chat.hint.habitat.1: People keep asking when the {{habitat}} pen will get some animals.
chat.hint.habitat.2: Fill up the {{habitat}} pen and I bet the reviews would go up.
chat.hint.habitat.3: The empty {{habitat}} pen made the loop feel a little unfinished.
chat.hint.habitat.4: I'd love to see something living in the {{habitat}} pen next time.
chat.mood.Happy.1: I'm having such a great time!
chat.mood.Happy.2: This is the best day I've had in ages.
chat.mood.Happy.4: Everything about this place makes me smile.
chat.mood.Happy.5: I'm going to tell everyone about this zoo!
chat.mood.Neutral.2: Not bad. Not bad at all.
chat.mood.Neutral.4: It's alright. I'll see how I feel by the end.
chat.mood.Unhappy.2: I'm not sure this was worth the trip.
chat.mood.Unhappy.3: My feet hurt, and I've seen better zoos.
chat.mood.Unhappy.5: I'm trying to enjoy this. I really am.
chat.persona.Explorer.Happy.1: I've tracked animals through deserts and jungles, and this place is still a thrill!
chat.persona.Explorer.Happy.2: Every pen here is like a little expedition. Splendid!
chat.persona.Explorer.Happy.3: Ah, the call of the wild, right here in Stardew Valley!
chat.persona.Explorer.Neutral.1: Not quite the wild, but a respectable collection.
chat.persona.Explorer.Neutral.2: I've seen these animals in nature. Here they look a bit... cozier.
chat.persona.Explorer.Neutral.3: Good habitats. I'd add more rocks, personally.
chat.persona.Explorer.Unhappy.1: I trekked three days through a jungle and was less disappointed than this.
chat.persona.Explorer.Unhappy.2: A true explorer needs more animals to explore.
chat.persona.Fancy.Happy.1: Magnifique! This zoo has real style.
chat.persona.Fancy.Happy.2: I've visited zoos all over the world, and this one is simply charming.
chat.persona.Fancy.Happy.3: I must send a postcard from here. Several, in fact.
chat.persona.Fancy.Neutral.2: Pleasant enough, though the gift shop is lacking. There is no gift shop.
chat.persona.Fancy.Neutral.3: I suppose it's charming, in a countryside sort of way.
chat.persona.Fancy.Unhappy.1: I did not travel all this way in these shoes for this.
chat.persona.Fancy.Unhappy.2: Darling, this is not what the brochure promised.
chat.persona.Fancy.Unhappy.3: I'll be writing a strongly worded postcard.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Happy.1: Fine. I'll admit it. This is a well-run operation.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Happy.2: Good margins, happy customers. Someone here knows business.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Happy.3: I haven't smiled this much since the quarterly report. Don't tell anyone.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Neutral.2: The customer experience could be optimized.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Neutral.3: I'm only here because my doctor said I need more fresh air.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Unhappy.1: Inefficient. Overpriced. I'd shut it down.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Unhappy.2: Back at JojaMart we'd never run a place like this.
chat.persona.Grumpy.Unhappy.3: I want to speak to the manager. Is that you?
chat.persona.Granny.Happy.1: Oh, sweetie, this zoo reminds me of being a little girl.
chat.persona.Granny.Happy.2: My grandchildren are going to love hearing about this!
chat.persona.Granny.Happy.3: Such lovely creatures. I brought crackers, but I won't feed them. Promise.
chat.persona.Granny.Neutral.1: It's a nice walk for these old legs.
chat.persona.Granny.Neutral.2: I've seen a lot of zoos in my day. This one's coming along, dear.
chat.persona.Granny.Neutral.3: Could use a few more benches, but it's sweet.
chat.persona.Granny.Unhappy.1: Oh dear. My knees came all this way for this?
chat.persona.Granny.Unhappy.2: Back in my day, a zoo had animals in it, dear.
chat.persona.Granny.Unhappy.3: I don't like to complain, sweetie, but... I'm a little disappointed.
chat.goodbye.Happy.1: I'd better keep moving! I'm giving this place {{stars}} stars, by the way.
chat.goodbye.Happy.2: Thanks for chatting! I'm off to see the rest!
chat.goodbye.Happy.3: See you around! I'll definitely be back.
chat.goodbye.Happy.4: Bye for now! I'll write you a {{stars}}-star review!
chat.goodbye.Neutral.1: Well, I should keep going. Nice talking to you.
chat.goodbye.Neutral.2: Okay, back to the animals. Bye!
chat.goodbye.Neutral.3: I'll think about my review on the way home. Maybe {{stars}} stars?
chat.goodbye.Unhappy.1: I need to go sit down. Goodbye.
chat.goodbye.Unhappy.2: That's enough chatting. I'm heading out soon.
chat.goodbye.Unhappy.3: I'm going to finish the loop and go home. {{stars}} stars, maybe.
chat.goodbye.Unhappy.4: Please, no more talking. I just want to see the rest and leave.
chat.species.Penguin.1: Look at the penguins waddle! I could watch them forever.
chat.species.Penguin.2: Do you think the penguins get cold, or is that the whole point?
chat.species.Penguin.3: One penguin slipped on the ice and acted like nothing happened. Legend.
chat.species.Penguin.4: I counted the penguins three times and got a different number each time.
chat.species.SeaLion.1: That sea lion just clapped at me! I think we're friends now.
chat.species.SeaLion.2: The sea lions are so noisy. I love them.
chat.species.SeaLion.3: I wish I could swim like that sea lion.
chat.species.SeaLion.4: That sea lion is totally showing off. Rightly so!
chat.species.Capybara.1: The capybara is so calm. I want to be a capybara.
chat.species.Capybara.2: They say everyone gets along with capybaras. I believe it.
chat.species.Capybara.3: That capybara hasn't moved in ten minutes. Total relaxation.
chat.species.Capybara.4: A capybara! It looks like a very serious potato.
chat.species.Flamingo.1: How do flamingos stand on one leg so long? I can barely do five seconds.
chat.species.Flamingo.2: So pink! The flamingos match my scarf.
chat.species.Flamingo.3: The flamingos look so elegant. I feel underdressed.
chat.species.Flamingo.4: I tried the flamingo pose. Nearly fell into the pond.
chat.species.NightHeron.1: The night heron looks so serious, like it's thinking about taxes.
chat.species.NightHeron.2: That heron hasn't blinked once. Is it judging me?
chat.species.NightHeron.3: A night heron! I usually only hear them at dusk.
chat.species.NightHeron.4: The heron just stands so still, waiting for a fish. Patience goals.
chat.species.Lion.1: The lion yawned and I saw all of its teeth. Yikes!
chat.species.Lion.2: The king of the jungle, napping like a house cat.
chat.species.Lion.3: I'm glad there's a fence between me and that lion.
chat.species.Lion.4: That mane! I wish my hair looked that good.
chat.species.Giraffe.1: The giraffe is so tall! I wonder what the weather's like up there.
chat.species.Giraffe.2: I think the giraffe looked right at me. I feel special.
chat.species.Giraffe.3: Giraffes have purple tongues, you know. I read it on a sign somewhere.
chat.species.Giraffe.4: That neck! How does it even scratch an itch?
chat.species.Elephant.1: The elephant waved its trunk at me! I waved back.
chat.species.Elephant.2: Elephants never forget, right? I hope it remembers me.
chat.species.Elephant.3: So big and so gentle. I love the elephant.
chat.species.Elephant.4: I felt the ground shake a little when the elephant walked by.
chat.species.Alpaca.1: The alpaca is so fluffy. I want to hug it.
chat.species.Alpaca.2: Is that an alpaca or a llama? I'm too afraid to ask.
chat.species.Alpaca.3: That alpaca has the funniest little smile.
chat.species.Alpaca.4: I bet alpaca wool makes the coziest sweaters.
chat.species.Monkey.1: The monkeys are so playful! One stuck its tongue out at me.
chat.species.Monkey.2: Watch out, I think that monkey wants my hat.
chat.species.Monkey.3: The monkeys remind me of my kids. Lots of energy, lots of noise.
chat.species.Monkey.4: That monkey just did a flip! Ten out of ten.
chat.species.Gorilla.1: The gorilla looked at me like it knew all my secrets.
chat.species.Gorilla.2: So strong, but so gentle. The gorilla is amazing.
chat.species.Gorilla.3: I think the gorilla is smarter than my cousin.
chat.species.Gorilla.4: The gorilla is just sitting there, thinking. Same, buddy.
chat.species.Panda.1: A panda! I can't believe there's a real panda in Stardew Valley!
chat.species.Panda.2: That panda has been eating bamboo for an hour. Living the dream.
chat.species.Panda.3: The panda rolled over and I nearly cried. So cute.
chat.species.Panda.4: Is it even legal to be that adorable?
chat.species.Bear.1: The bear looks so cuddly, but I know better.
chat.species.Bear.2: I think the bear is looking for honey.
chat.species.Bear.3: That bear stood up on two legs. It's taller than me!
chat.species.Bear.4: I'd love to know what the bear dreams about.
chat.species.Raccoon.1: A raccoon! I'm sure I saw one going through the trash in town.
chat.species.Raccoon.2: The raccoon is washing its food. So polite!
chat.species.Raccoon.3: Those tiny hands! The raccoon looks like it's planning a heist.
chat.species.Raccoon.4: Is that the raccoon from the forest? It looks very important.
chat.species.Owl.1: The owl turned its head all the way around! How?
chat.species.Owl.2: Hoo hoo! Sorry, I couldn't help it.
chat.species.Owl.3: The owl looks so wise. I bet it knows everything.
chat.species.Owl.4: I think the owl is only pretending to sleep.
chat.species.Deer.1: The deer are so graceful. Like something out of a storybook.
chat.species.Deer.2: I've seen deer in Cindersap Forest, but never this close.
chat.species.Deer.3: That little deer has such big eyes.
chat.species.Deer.4: The deer jumped when I sneezed. Sorry, deer.
chat.species.Dinosaur.1: Is... is that a real dinosaur?!
chat.species.Dinosaur.2: A dinosaur in a zoo! How did they even manage that?
chat.species.Dinosaur.3: I'm not sure whether to be amazed or run away.
chat.species.Dinosaur.4: My son is never going to believe I saw a real dinosaur.

plaque.default.PlaqueIce.title: Ice Habitat
plaque.default.PlaqueIce.body:
Home to our penguins from the far south.
They can't fly, but underwater they zoom like little torpedoes.
Penguin parents take turns keeping the egg warm. No tapping on the glass!
plaque.default.PlaqueWater.title: Aquarium Habitat
plaque.default.PlaqueWater.body:
Sea lions, capybaras, flamingos and night herons share these waters.
Sea lions love to show off, capybaras get along with everyone, and flamingos owe their pink to shrimp.
plaque.default.PlaqueSavanna.title: Savanna Habitat
plaque.default.PlaqueSavanna.body:
Lions, giraffes, elephants and alpacas roam the grasslands.
Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day, giraffes have purple tongues, and alpacas spit when annoyed. Be polite!
plaque.default.PlaqueJungle.title: Tropics Habitat
plaque.default.PlaqueJungle.body:
The leafy tropics are home to monkeys, gorillas and pandas.
Monkeys swing through the branches, gorillas are gentle giants, and pandas munch bamboo half the day.
plaque.default.PlaqueForest.title: Forest Habitat
plaque.default.PlaqueForest.body:
Bears, raccoons, owls and deer live among these trees.
Bears sleep through winter, raccoons wash their food, and owls turn their heads almost all the way round.
plaque.default.PlaquePrehistoric.title: Prehistoric Habitat
plaque.default.PlaquePrehistoric.body:
Welcome to the prehistoric world!
Dinosaurs ruled the Earth for over 150 million years, and today's birds are their descendants.
Please don't feed them. Or ride them.
plaque.default.SignpostIceWater.title: Ice & Aquarium
plaque.default.SignpostIceWater.body: This way to the penguins, sea lions, capybaras, flamingos and night herons.
plaque.default.SignpostSavannaJungle.bod: This way to the lions, giraffes, elephants, alpacas, monkeys, gorillas and pandas.
plaque.default.SignpostForestPrehistoric: This way to the bears, raccoons, owls, deer... and the dinosaurs!
plaque.default.ZooSign.title: Welcome to the Zoo!
plaque.default.ZooSign.body:
Open daily from 6am to 6pm.
Please don't feed the animals, and help keep the park tidy. Enjoy your visit!
